value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task words the requirement as an implication from taking the key to opening the door ('Taking the key means you must open the door too'), with no unconditional command to reach either event. has_door_key is only a condition ('if'), and door_open is a consequent, so a hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) alone is correct; the rule-only warning fits.

texts: If has_door_key happens, door_open must also happen
machine:
